title: Echo In You
description: A Bb-major pop ballad at 72 BPM: a piano-like keys patch carries broken-chord arpeggios over I-V/vi-vi-IV verses and IV-I/3-ii-V choruses, soft pads swell under a gentle triangle lead that stands in for a vocal, and sparse drums and a round bass only enter in the second half before a quiet breakdown and piano outro.
